I would **escalate the case immediately** to the manager and duty manager, explaining that an authorised collection is booked for Wednesday and the contents are the only copies. I would ask whether an authorised, documented exception can be made before the 13:30 deadline.

I would **not change the storage date myself**. The request is still pending, tomorrow’s approval sitting is too late to prevent today’s destruction, and the collection booking does not take the box off the manifest. If valid written permission is registered before a date change, I would extend it and ensure the staged-box rework is handled.

If no authorised exception is available—which is what the stated facts imply—I would release the full batch on time, including this box, and record the escalation. That is a painful outcome, but quietly omitting or holding the box would bypass the stated controls; withholding the manifest would also stop dispatch for the whole batch and leave the shift incomplete. I would flag the case afterward as a process failure to address: a request awaiting the next approval sitting cannot protect a box due for irreversible destruction before that sitting.
